name: i-Bhugoal PS_Code / MHA ps_cd shared code space (derived concordance)
publisher: derived from i-Bhugoal (Govt of Bihar) and MHA police station master
caveats: Not a published crosswalk - established here by parsing both files in full
Code space is shared but not identical: 734/929 MHA Bihar codes have a polygon twin
Disagrees with 6 of 684 currently-accepted crosswalk rows (0.9%), 4 of them where the coded polygon is an O.P. - likely outpost-upgrade or thana-split events
Must never silently override a 'confirmed' tier or a >=0.90 name match
evidence: Parsed all 896 polygons and all 929 Bihar MHA points. Intersection of PS_Code and ps_cd = 734 codes (79.0% of MHA Bihar). Name similarity on the intersection: mean 0.923, median 1.000, 651 at >=0.8. Code join agrees with 678/684 accepted crosswalk rows; the 6 disagreements are ps_cd 5793002, 5130023, 5118004, 5133001, 5133033, 5123004. Against the live 99-row review_queue it resolves 25 rows, 8 of them also containment-confirmed, 24 of 25 with district agreement.
notes: Join key is literally thana_id == f'BH-{ps_cd_mha}'; geography.py:216 already mints thana_id that way and geography.py:257 keeps ps_cd_mha. Highest-value action in this dossier and needs no new data.

name: SOI Police Stations (Survey of India point locations)
publisher: Survey of India, via ramSeraph/indian_facilities mirror
license: CC0-1.0 per repo LICENSE; attribute Datameet and Survey of India
caveats: HAS NO STATION NAME FIELD OF ANY KIND - cannot be name-joined to anything
addl_info non-empty on only 359/12141 and remarks on 674/12141; neither is a name
Survey of India upstream (indiamaps.gov.in) is .gov.in and blocked from this session
Listed by indianopenmaps under 'not-so-open', so upstream redistribution terms are not clearly open despite the mirror's CC0 assertion
evidence: Downloaded 440,566 B .7z to data/raw/, extracted to 5,979,974 B geojsonl, parsed 12,141 features. Fields: objectid_12, objectid, addl_info, photograph, gmrotation, unique_id, svy_date, orig_fid, objectid_1, subdivision, district, state, remarks, lgd_state_code, lgd_district_code, lgd_sub_dist_code, soi_code. 608 features with state=BIHAR.
notes: Downloaded to data/raw/SOI_PoliceStations.geojsonl(.7z). Only real use is lgd_sub_dist_code as a subdistrict sanity layer for QA of district_conflicts. Does not help resolve the review queue.

name: ESRI LivingAtlas India Police Stations
publisher: ESRI India LivingAtlas, via ramSeraph/indian_facilities mirror
license: CC0-1.0 asserted by mirror; ESRI LivingAtlas upstream terms UNCLEAR - verify before publishing
caveats: Compiled/crowd-derived - must not outvote MHA or i-Bhugoal
Names are inconsistent free text: 'Police Station' with no place name, 'Bivha House Police Camp', 'Medni Chowki Ps'
Only 22 of 872 Bihar names are marked chowki/outpost, so it does NOT reliably distinguish thana from O.P.
'code' field (PS#####, on 460/872) is an ESRI-internal id with no relation to MHA ps_cd
Field is misspelled 'villgae' in the source
evidence: Downloaded 359,091 B .7z to data/raw/, extracted to 4,687,540 B geojsonl, parsed 14,984 features. Fields: objectid, policestationname, code, villgae, subdistrict, district, state, country. 872 features with state=Bihar across 38 districts; name shapes 692 'Station', 158 other, 22 chowki/outpost; 460 have a code.
notes: Downloaded to data/raw/LivingAtlas_PoliceStations.geojsonl(.7z). Genuinely new signal is 'villgae' + 'subdistrict' - supports a village-mediated join against LGD_Villages as a review-queue PROPOSAL only, never an auto-accept.

name: indianopenmaps layer catalogue (listing.json, 574 layers)
caveats: An index, not data
Release ASSETS still cannot be enumerated from this session (api.github.com and repo HTML are proxy-blocked); the index is the substitute
evidence: Cloned repo and parsed worker/src/routes/listing.json: 574 layer entries. Police layers found: Bihar (Bhugoal_BH_Police_Thana_Boundaries, the ONLY Bihar one), Karnataka x3 (police/railway/traffic), Rajasthan x2 (Rajdharaa police + GRP), Tamil Nadu x2 (TNGIS police + traffic), Telangana, Andhra Pradesh (APSAC), Delhi (GSDL), NCOG marine, plus national point sets SOI/LivingAtlas/MP. Bihar entry records source as 'i-Bhugoal - https://gis.bih.nic.in/'.
notes: This is the evidence that closes hunt item 1: there is NO newer Bihar boundary set and NO separate outpost layer. Also probed and got 404 for Bhugoal_BH_Police_District_Boundaries, _OP_Boundaries, _Outpost_Boundaries, _Range_Boundaries and every manifest filename.

name: LGD full daily archive (Local Government Directory dump)
caveats: DECISIVE NEGATIVE: LGD has no Bihar police-station entity. 'Police Station' is an LGD subdistrict TYPE only for state code 21 (Odisha), where the P.S. is the revenue unit. Bihar (state 10) subdistricts are Blocks/Circles.
Data site is on github.io, which is egress-blocked here; lgdirectory.gov.in is also blocked
Upstream scraping requires breaking a captcha (the repo ships tesseract-based captcha code), which bears on terms of use
evidence: Cloned ramSeraph/opendata (master) and read lgd/README.md and lgd/wikidata/common.py. In common.py the per-state subdistrict type table gives suffix 'Police Station' / label 'P.S.' ONLY under key '21' (Odisha), with the comment 'Tehsils exist, Police station maps are available in the Census Atlas'. No Bihar police entity anywhere in the LGD component set. The data site itself returned no content (github.io blocked).
notes: This closes hunt item 4 on the merits, not merely on access: a village-to-thana rebuild from LGD is impossible for Bihar because LGD does not model it.
how_to_obtain: From an unrestricted network fetch the daily CSV archives listed at https://ramseraph.github.io/opendata/lgd/ (see its 'List Of All Daily Archives' link), or run the scraper: git clone https://github.com/ramSeraph/opendata, cd lgd, pip install -r requirements.txt, install tesseract, then `python -m scrape -m COMPS` to list components and `python -m scrape -m RUN -p 10`. Note this breaks lgdirectory.gov.in's captcha - review terms of use first. For Bihar this yields NO police-station entity, so it is worth doing only for village/block/panchayat codes.

name: OpenStreetMap Bihar amenity=police features
license: ODbL-1.0 (share-alike - affects any derived boundary we publish)
caveats: NOT ATTEMPTED - no OSM data was obtained and no claim is made about its contents
ODbL share-alike would attach to derived jurisdiction geometry; a licence review is needed before this feeds published polygons
OSM Bihar police coverage is uneven and names are user-entered
evidence: All endpoints failed CONNECT with proxy 403 and zero bytes: overpass-api.de, overpass.kumi.systems, overpass.osm.ch, overpass.private.coffee, download.geofabrik.de, osm-internal.download.geofabrik.de, planet.openstreetmap.org.
how_to_obtain: From an unrestricted network run Overpass: [out:json][timeout:60];area["ISO3166-2"="IN-BR"][admin_level=4]->.a;(node(area.a)[amenity=police];way(area.a)[amenity=police];);out center tags; Or download asia/india-latest.osm.pbf from Geofabrik and filter amenity=police with osmium. Keep name, official_name, alt_name, operator, addr:district, police=* .
notes: Remains the best untried lead for distinguishing outposts: OSM often spells them 'X Outpost' or carries the parent thana in the name, and would independently test the ~3% of MHA coordinates believed wrong.
